title: Advanced JSONB & SQL/JSON Path Expressions
description: Query complex nested documents using jsonb_path_query, jsonb_set, and transform schemas dynamically.

data.text: PostgreSQL implements the SQL:2016 standard for **SQL/JSON path expressions** (`jsonb_path_query`, `jsonb_path_exists`). JSON Path allows traversing deep, polymorphic JSON trees using JavaScript-like dot notation and predicate filters.

data.title: Querying Nested JSON Arrays with JSON Path
data.content: Extracting items filtered by nested conditions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: JSON Path (`jsonb_path_query`) provides standard path traversal syntax.
Use `jsonb_set` to mutate specific nested keys without replacing the whole document.
Combine JSON Path with GIN indexing for ultra-fast document search.
